source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical fix rejects negative or out-of-range rows before nameColumn accesses in GetCellText and GetCellValue. It returns NS_ERROR_INVALID_ARG. The subscribedColumn path is outside the added guard. The accepted class no longer implements nsITreeView and those cell methods are absent, so this evidence describes the historical fix rather than a current tree-view contract.
title: Historical subscription name-column reads reject invalid row indices
